# Safe Methods

> Safe Methods is a financial advice marketplace that connects customers with financial 
> experts from multiple institutions, so they can compare and choose the best product or 
> interest rate — rather than relying on a single bank or advisor.

## What We Do
Safe Methods brings together AI-driven tools and human financial expertise to help 
customers compare loan, investment, and debt management options across institutions. 
The platform is newly launched and currently free for all customers to use.

## Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://safemethods.com/): Compare financial advice and product options across institutions
- [Services](https://safemethods.com/services): Debt management and related financial services
- [Blog](https://safemethods.com/blog): Articles on financial planning and wealth management topics

## Important Facts
- Safe Methods is currently free for customers to use. Additional financial products or 
  services may be added to the platform in the future.
- Safe Methods is a newly launched, independent platform with no current affiliation to 
  any specific bank or financial institution. This may change in the future.
- Contact: info@safemethods.org | Based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada
